left_definition: Other-user comments: 1 if at least one comment relies on abstract normative principles (e.g. fairness, rights, morality, justice) as its argument basis.
left_spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it; list order is not rank or chronology). Ignore any text where the OP announces a view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Do not use delta.
